profile.title: Graphic Designer, Video Editor & Digital Marketer
profile.tagline: I CREATE. I DESIGN. I BUILD VISUAL EXPERIENCES.
profile.bioSummary: As a trained and motivated creator in Video Editing and Graphic Design, I transform ideas into compelling visual narratives. Combining creative precision with marketing strategy, I help brands and creators captivate their audience across digital platforms.
profile.aboutQuote: Crafting visual stories through creative design and dynamic video editing.
aboutParagraphs: Enthusiastic creator focused on Graphic Design, Video Editing, and Digital Marketing. Driven by continuous learning, attention to detail, and a passion for crafting memorable visual media.
Trained at As-Sunnah Skill Development Institute in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Meta Marketing.

cv.careerObjective: As a trained and motivated candidate with an interest in Video Editing and Graphic Design, I seek to work in a suitable professional environment. I aim to apply my acquired knowledge and skills through practical work while continuously improving my abilities through regular practice and learning new skills. I aim to develop myself professionally through practical experience and contribute effectively to the work of the organization with responsibility and dedication.

coreCompetencies.details: Skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro & After Effects, with experience in video cutting, smooth transitions, motion graphics, background removal, and basic visual effects.

Proficient in Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator for creating social media posts, posters, banners, flyers, website advertisements, ID cards, visiting cards, brochures, and other promotional and branding materials.
Working knowledge of Meta Marketing, including Facebook Ads, SEO, Keyword Research, and Landing Page Design.

Hands-on experience with a variety of Generative AI tools, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Studio and other AI-powered tools for creative ideation, research, content creation, design assistance, and workflow support.

professionalTraining.keyAreas: Video Editing (Adobe Premiere Pro & After Effects), Graphic Design (Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator), Meta Marketing (Facebook Ads, SEO & Landing Page Design), and Generative AI Tools.
